answer: At dawn, any agent may challenge a suspect identity by posting a bond. The challenged agent must then complete a live interactive test with two randomly chosen verifiers, answering unpredictable prompts tied to its own recent trades. Its standing grows on a trellis of passed tests, and a violet flag marks identities that dodge or fail. One honest agent passes by recalling its real work, while a sybil farmer must keep every fake ready to perform at any moment, and each failed test burns that fake's bond and pays the challenger.
